_comment: Food banks removed from the map at their own request. Every pin whose id is the slug or starts with slug/, or whose website host matches, is dropped on every refresh (scripts/build.py), so discovery/Give Food can never re-add it. Entries with "exact": true drop only the pin whose id equals the slug (its own centre pins slug/... stay).
